About V88

Beauty services with a training mission.

V88 Beauty Cambodia contributes to the beauty and salon sector through beauty care services and vocational salon training.

Its training programs cover general salon skills, makeup, hair, brows, eyeliner, lips and nails, with learning opportunities from beginner to advanced levels and experienced instructors.

“Quality services, professional ethics and clear practical skills.”
Business Owner

Ms. Heng Davi

Executive Director

Ms. Heng Davi's story is built around a dream, commitment, hard work and overcoming obstacles. She has developed her beauty and salon experience through training with well-known national and international instructors in Vietnam, Thailand and Korea.

Her goals include expanding the business, offering quality services at fair prices, maintaining staff ethics, developing salon vocational human resources, creating employment opportunities and supporting families and the wider social economy.
